name: playwright-ai-qa-framework
description: Production-style Playwright TypeScript quality engineering platform with governed AI-assisted testing capabilities

scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run env:check
scripts.app:health: node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/health').then(async (response) => console.log(response.status, await response.text())).catch(() => { console.error('NexusShop is unavailable'); process.exitCode = 1; })"
scripts.intelligence:full: cross-env INTELLIGENCE_RUN_TYPE=full-regression INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SOURCE=local INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SCOPE=mixed npm run intelligence
scripts.intelligence:framework: cross-env INTELLIGENCE_RUN_TYPE=framework INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SOURCE=local INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SCOPE=framework npm run intelligence
scripts.intelligence:api: cross-env INTELLIGENCE_RUN_TYPE=api INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SOURCE=local INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SCOPE=api npm run intelligence
scripts.intelligence:chromium: cross-env INTELLIGENCE_RUN_TYPE=browser INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SOURCE=local INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SCOPE=chromium npm run intelligence
scripts.intelligence:firefox: cross-env INTELLIGENCE_RUN_TYPE=browser INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SOURCE=local INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SCOPE=firefox npm run intelligence
scripts.intelligence:webkit: cross-env INTELLIGENCE_RUN_TYPE=browser INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SOURCE=local INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SCOPE=webkit npm run intelligence
scripts.intelligence:targeted:firefox: cross-env INTELLIGENCE_RUN_TYPE=targeted INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SOURCE=local INTELLIGENCE_RUN_SCOPE=firefox npm run intelligence

author: Bhavesh Nama
